versions.content: Support sub-function 0x04 of UDS service 0x19. Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support sub-function 0x04 of UDS service 0x19 to retrieve snapshot records stored for DTCs. Rationale: Provide means to retrieve snapshot records. Use Case: capture data at various points in time when faults occur in the system. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: ISO 14229-1
